source.description:
PROBLEM
Supervisor.ts (2727 lines) has three tactical shrinks that survived adversarial review by the reviewer specialist (job 95c5d5, PARTIAL 72, SCRUTINY high). Total ~15 lines out with zero shape change and zero closure-state risk. Filed as chore so this doesn't rot forever after unitAI-yme9q.2 audit.

DO NOT attempt the run() phase-extraction here — reviewer refuted it (F1 REFUTED, gitnexus_impact direct=3 depth2=10 risk=CRITICAL, closure-state problem). That's a separate future bead if operator ever decides supervisor.test.ts FIFO hang is worth fixing first.

SCOPE
Three cuts, all in src/specialist/supervisor.ts:

1. F3 — finalize output-fetch ternary shrink at L900-902:
   Current:
     const output = existsSync(outputPath)
       ? (readFileSync(outputPath, 'utf-8') || this.readResult(id) || '')
       : (this.readResult(id) || '');
   Replace with:
     const fileOutput = existsSync(outputPath) ? readFileSync(outputPath, 'utf-8') : '';
     const output = fileOutput || this.readResult(id) || '';
   Reviewer CONFIRMED — same semantics on all inputs (empty file, missing file, readFileSync throw). Net: -1 line.

2. F2 (narrowed) — ignore() helper for pure-swallow teardown sites only at L2699, L2709-L2712, L2715, L2719:
   Add to Supervisor class scope:
     const ignore = (fn: () => void): void => { try { fn(); } catch { /* teardown best-effort */ } };
   Rewrite THESE lines only:
     L2699: ignore(() => process.kill(statusWatchdogPid, 'SIGTERM'));
     L2709: ignore(() => fifoReadline?.close());
     L2710: ignore(() => fifoReadStream?.once('error', swallowBenignFifoError));
     L2711: ignore(() => fifoReadStream?.destroy());
     L2712: if (fifoFd !== undefined) { ignore(() => closeSync(fifoFd)); fifoFd = undefined; }
     L2715: if (eventsFd !== undefined) { ignore(() => fsyncSync(eventsFd)); closeSync(eventsFd); }
     L2719: ignore(() => { if (existsSync(fifoPath)) rmSync(fifoPath); });
   DO NOT wrap swallowBenignFifoError (has non-trivial EBADF-vs-other logic — rethrows on non-EBADF, must stay explicit).
   DO NOT wrap the unguarded closeSync(eventsFd) after fsyncSync (must-succeed on close, best-effort on fsync — mixing is intentional).
   Reviewer NARROWED F2 to exactly this set. Net: ~-5 lines + one clear intent instead of seven copies.

3. NEW (reviewer-surfaced) — L1241-L1299 lineage assembly dedupe:
   Two adjacent code paths (startupContext + initialStatus) both assemble lineage/worktree/base-sha/branch fields with substantial overlap. Reviewer flagged as real duplication I missed. Extract shared local object builder INSIDE run() scope (NOT a class private method — reviewer refuted class-level extraction). Net: ~-8 to -10 lines.
   Note: this cut IS inside run()'s CRITICAL blast zone even though it's a local dedupe. Must verify via test run.

CONSTRAINTS
- No behavior change on any of the three cuts.
- Zero API shape change (no public method signature edits).
- No changes to run() control flow, watchdog logic, SIGTERM handler, or FIFO steer.
- No touching the yme9q terminal-alive detection code (already merged, tested).

VALIDATION
- bunx tsc --noEmit clean.
- bun --bun vitest run tests/unit/specialist/supervisor-*.test.ts (except supervisor.test.ts — quarantined FIFO hang, known issue).
- Live smoke: dispatch any keep-alive specialist against a fresh bead, let it reach waiting, sp stop, verify normal shutdown. Terminal transitions must fire in same order (run_complete, tmux cleanup, FIFO rm, dispose).
- git diff to confirm the three chunks are the only touches.

OUTPUT
One PR titled "refactor(supervisor): ponytail tactical cuts (F3 + narrow F2 + lineage dedupe)". Reference this bead and cite the reviewer verdict at unitAI-yme9q.2 (job 95c5d5).

NON_GOALS
- run() phase extraction (blocked by supervisor.test.ts FIFO hang + closure-state problem — separate future bead if ever justified).
- Any structural change beyond the three cuts.
- Any test rewrite beyond adding coverage for the dedupe if the branch coverage drops.
- Commenting on ponytail integration into specialist prompts — that's a separate epic the operator is drafting.
source.title: supervisor.ts: ponytail tactical cuts (F3 output-fetch + narrow ignore helper + L1241-L1299 lineage-assembly dedupe)
